name: Marrubiu (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Marrubiu (a church, a fork, wheat and green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Marrubiu, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Marrubiu arms — church, fork, wheat and green, crowned, within branches
